title: OISS v0.2 feed manifest
description: What one system sends into a store's OISS data, or reads from it: each record type and the OISS versions it uses. Not a record. A retailer keeps one per connected system, so it can see who must move before a version is retired. See spec/feeds.md.

oissversion.description: The OISS version this manifest follows.

system.description: The system, as named in its records' provenance.system.

source.description: The CloudEvents source its records carry, or a prefix of it.

stores.description: The stores it serves. Left out means every store.

produces.description: Record types it writes, and the version of each it writes now.

reads.description: Record types it reads, and every version of each it can read.

contact.description: Who to ask about this system's upgrades: a team or role, not a person's private address.

extensions.description: Extension namespaces it writes or understands on this type.
